questions.text:
Mia has 3 stickers.
Her friend gives her 4 more.
How many stickers does she have altogether?

Sam sees 6 ducks in the pond.
2 more swim over.
How many ducks are there in total?

There are 4 frogs on a log.
5 more jump on.
How many frogs are there in total?

There are 2 apples in the bowl.
Mum puts in 5 more.
How many apples are in the bowl now?

There are 3 ladybirds on a leaf.
5 more land on it.
How many ladybirds are on the leaf now?

exampleOverride.text:
There are 3 children in the park.
2 more arrive.
How many children are there altogether?
